LLANTR.description: Traffic Line Lane - Transverse (LLANTR). Defines a transverse moving-load traffic lane by name and its lane data; lane elements/factors are provided either directly via LANE_ITEMS or in bulk (import) via SPECIAL_LANE_ITEMS, which are mutually exclusive.

LL_NAME.description: Name of the traffic line lane (transverse).

LANE_ITEMS.description: Lane Data (TR): list of lane elements with load factors. Mutually exclusive with SPECIAL_LANE_ITEMS - providing both is an error. Optional (default empty).

ELEM.description: Element number for this lane item.

FACTOR.description: Load factor applied to this element.

SPECIAL_LANE_ITEMS.description: Used only when importing: bulk input that expands into LANE_ITEMS (each key element in ELEMS gets FACTOR). Mutually exclusive with LANE_ITEMS - providing both is an error. Optional (default empty).

items.description: A group of key elements sharing one load factor.

ELEMS.description: Key Elements: element numbers that share the same factor.

FACTOR.description: Load factor applied to every element in ELEMS.
